meta.title: Configurator: {name}
meta.description: Configure the {name} project in 3D: footprint, storeys, roof, facade, windows, terrace, insulation and building services, with the estimate and schedule updated at once.
meta.pickerDescription: Choose a project and configure it in 3D: the itemised estimate and the build time update at every step.

picker.title: Configurator
picker.lead: Choose a project, then do everything in 3D: footprint and plan, storeys, roof, facade, windows, terrace, insulation and building services. The estimate and the build time update at every step.

restrictions.requiredBy: {systems} depends on this system. Remove it first.
restrictions.atticRoof: An attic does not fit under a {roof} roof: choose a gable or gambrel roof.

geometry.OPENING_OUT_OF_WALL: With this footprint the windows do not fit in the wall.
geometry.OPENINGS_OVERLAP: With this footprint windows and doors run into each other.
geometry.TERRACE_OUT_OF_WALL: The terrace does not fit along the wall.
geometry.TERRACE_ENTRANCE: The terrace does not adjoin an entrance door.
geometry.ENTRANCE_INVALID: With this footprint there is no room for a porch and steps at the entrance.
geometry.other: The house cannot be built like this: check the footprint and the windows.

estimate.title: Estimate
estimate.note: Prices include materials, delivery and assembly. Item amounts are exact; the catalog’s “from” price is rounded.

share.title: Configuration saved
share.lead: The link opens exactly this configuration at today’s price, even if the tariff changes later.
share.error: Could not save. Check the connection and try again.
share.limited: Too many saves in a row. Try again in a few minutes.

saved.savedAt: Saved on {date}, prices under tariff revision {revision}
saved.changed: Prices have changed since: today this configuration costs {amount}.
saved.unavailable: This configuration cannot be repeated exactly today: the catalog has changed. The estimate below is as it was saved.
saved.restored: The saved configuration cannot be opened as it was because the catalog has changed. The project opens with its defaults.

stage.label: 3D model: {project}
stage.unsupported: This browser cannot show 3D. The estimate and every option still work.
